cohort: The study included all women in Sweden who delivered a live or stillborn infant between 1987 and 2019.
finding: The incidence of pregnancy-related pulmonary embolism (PE) increased from 1987 to 2019, while deep vein thrombosis (DVT) decreased from 1993 to 2019, and the overall VTE incidence remained stable, possibly due to increased thromboprophylaxis.
